verdict.rationale: Paddle documents a public Billing API with Bearer-token auth, granular key permissions, key rotation and rate-limit pages, plus an OpenAPI 3.1 spec, a Postman collection covering every operation, and four official server-side SDKs. Transactions, reports and metrics are explicitly drivable via the API. The probe 404s on guessed OpenAPI paths do not contradict this, because the spec is documented as living in the PaddleHQ/paddle-openapi GitHub repo. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration that the API works end to end.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can drive the product through a documented public API

citations.quote: To authenticate, pass your Paddle API key using the `Authorization` header and the `Bearer` prefix.
Paddle publishes an OpenAPI 3.1 specification for the Paddle Billing API.
The Paddle Postman collection includes every operation, so you can try the API interactively before writing code.
Permissions grant an API key access to specific entities or allow it to take specific actions in Paddle.
you can create your own transactions using the API or Paddle dashboard.
